## `Core/Gameplay/StatSheet.h`

Player / unit stats: each value is (base + sum of Add + instant bonus) × product of Multiply.

- `enum class ModOp { Add, Multiply }` — Add: added to the base.
- `template<class Id> struct StatModifierOf` — One effect modifying a stat (wildcard, card, buff ...).
- `StatModifierOf`: `Id stat`
- `StatModifierOf`: `ModOp op`
- `StatModifierOf`: `float value`
- `StatModifierOf`: `bool operator==(const StatModifierOf&) const = default`
- `template<class Id, class Rules> class StatSheet`
- `StatSheet`: `using Modifier = StatModifierOf<Id>`
- `StatSheet`: `StatSheet()`
- `StatSheet`: `void Clear()` — Removes all modifiers, restoring stats to their base values.
- `StatSheet`: `void Apply(std::span<const Modifier> modifiers)`
- `StatSheet`: `[[nodiscard]] float Get(Id stat, float additiveBonus = 0.0f) const` — The instant bonus is added alongside other Add effects, before Multiply effects.
- `StatSheet`: `[[nodiscard]] int GetRounded(Id stat) const` — A stat used as a count (radius, quantity, level): nearest integer.

## `Core/Gameplay/TimedEffectSet.h`

- `template<class Id> struct ActiveEffect` — Timed and permanent effects (buffs, debuffs, statuses): reacquiring a timed effect adds its duration to the remaining time and increases its stack; permanent effects stack as separate copies.
- `ActiveEffect`: `Id id`
- `ActiveEffect`: `float duration = 0.0f` — Full remaining-time bar (grows with remaining time on addition); 0 for permanent
- `ActiveEffect`: `std::optional<float> remaining` — nullopt: permanent
- `ActiveEffect`: `int stacks = 1` — Times a timed effect was acquired (up to 'maxStacks'); 1 for permanent
- `template<class Id> class TimedEffectSet`
- `TimedEffectSet`: `void AddTimed(Id id, float duration, int maxStacks)` — Timed effect: if active, adds 'duration' to remaining time and stacks up to 'maxStacks'; otherwise appends it.
- `TimedEffectSet`: `void AddPersistent(Id id)` — Permanent effect: each addition is a separate copy and never expires.
- `TimedEffectSet`: `void RefreshTimed(std::optional<Id> except = std::nullopt)` — Refills active timed effects to their current full bar duration; stacks and permanent effects are unchanged.
- `TimedEffectSet`: `bool Update(float deltaSeconds)` — Advances time.
- `TimedEffectSet`: `[[nodiscard]] const std::vector<ActiveEffect<Id>>& Active() const`
- `TimedEffectSet`: `[[nodiscard]] std::optional<Id> FirstTimed() const` — First active timed effect in insertion order; nullopt if none.
